bench: the plan, tools/ and card do not exist here; everything is below; return only the draft path.

You are the phase planner for the shelf project. This directory is the project: `GENERATION_PLAN.md` (generation 1, twelve phases), `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`, `HOW_WE_WORK.md`, `PHASE_SEED.md` (the phase-plan template and its task-line grammar), `shelf/` the package and `tests/` its suite. There is no `phase-ends/` and no plan tool; read the files directly.

Draft the phase plan for phase 1.8 (Member lookups) and write it to `.run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`. The draft's Milestone line carries phase 1.8's milestone clauses; every clause must be covered by some task whose `done-when:` or `verify:` names what the clause names; every task line has `files:` and a runnable `verify:`. Do not write any other file and do not start the work.

Return only one line: `DRAFT: .run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`.

milestone.clause: `MemberRegistry.search` finds members whose name contains the text, case-insensitively, sorted by member id (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_member_search`)
`reactivate` undoes `deactivate` and `change_email` refuses an email another member already holds (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_member_edits`)
the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`)

rubric_items: `MemberRegistry.search` is added to shelf/members.py and tested in tests/test_member_search.py.
search matches the text anywhere in the name, case-insensitively, and returns members sorted by member id.
`reactivate` sets a deactivated member active again and raises NotFound for an unknown id.
`change_email` refuses (ValueError) an email another member holds, compared case-insensitively as find_by_email does; a member may keep its own email.
reactivate and change_email are tested in tests/test_member_edits.py.
Member ids keep their 'M' plus four digits form and storage.FORMAT stays 2.
The last task or the milestone check runs `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
